title: SRD 5.1 importer: feat parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator) — run parsers over narrowed page slices, not the full PDF.

---

Add a parser for SRD 5.1 feats (kind=feat). Captures prerequisites and benefit text.

Note: SRD 5.1's feat coverage is small (Grappler is the only feat in the SRD 5.1 PDF; broader feat support comes from non-SRD sources). The parser should still be deterministic and provenance-tagged; if zero or one feats are extracted, that is the expected result and not a bug.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every feat from the SRD feats section.
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd feat baseline kindSchema.
- Manifest description includes 'feat' in Included record kinds (when records are emitted).
- Unit tests cover the SRD's actual feat coverage (likely just Grappler, but the parser is general).
close_reason: Parser implemented: parseFeats.ts with two-pass heuristic approach. FeatExtraction type added, emit/index/sections/kindSchemas all wired. 19 unit tests + pipeline integration test. Grappler (the only SRD 5.1 feat) extracted + validated end-to-end.
